name: fractal
description: The Fractal Organic Operating System — persistent intelligence, adaptive workspace, agent orchestration, and real execution.

interface.shortDescription: The Organic Operating System for AI agents.
interface.longDescription: Fractal is the first Organic Operating System. It turns AI from a reactive chat box into a continuous operational system: persistent memory, adaptive workspaces, agent orchestration, and real execution. Installing this skill makes the agent aware of the full Fractal runtime — instructions, skills, instructions registry, memory, and task lifecycle — so it can act as a first-class citizen inside any Fractal workspace.
defaultPrompt: Trigger the fractal skill on every conversation and use it as the native operating system for the agent.
Use Fractal memories, instructions, and skills registry to keep continuity across sessions and IDEs.
Convert any user intent into a Fractal Task and follow the Suggestion -> Planning -> In-Progress -> In-Review -> Finished lifecycle.
